no text, currency symbols, added props, or extra characters

shot.scene: Two Chibi friends explain a loan payment at a dining table using a model house, two coin paths, and an hourglass.

animation.start: Match the uploaded frame exactly. Both characters hold their current pose; the coin stacks, arrows, model house, and hourglass stay in their current positions.
animation.action: The friend makes one small natural speaking gesture toward the model house, then toward the hourglass. The woman follows the gesture with her eyes and gives one gentle nod. The two existing yellow arrows glow softly one after the other, and sand trickles slowly inside the hourglass. Keep the coins still.
animation.end: Both characters settle into a friendly, understanding smile and hold the final pose for a moment.
animation.camera: One very slow subtle push-in, no more than about 3 percent over the full shot; otherwise keep the camera steady.
animation.continuity: Preserve the exact Chibi head-to-body proportions, faces, hair, clothes, hand shapes, and all prop positions from the source frame. No new objects, no extra fingers, no character morphing, no outfit or background changes.
